SUPABASE SETUP SPEC

Objective:
Create Supabase project and required database schema for PG Like Home.

Steps:

Create Supabase project

Enable email auth

Create tables:

Tables:

users

id (uuid, primary key, references auth.users.id)

name (text)

email (text)

phone (text)

role (text, values: admin or resident)

room_id (uuid, nullable)

join_date (date)

rooms

id (uuid, primary key)

room_type (text)

rent (numeric)

capacity (int)

payments

id (uuid, primary key)

user_id (uuid, foreign key → users.id)

month (text)

amount (numeric)

status (text: paid or pending)

payment_date (date)

complaints

id (uuid, primary key)

user_id (uuid, foreign key)

message (text)

status (text: open, in_progress, resolved)

created_at (timestamp)

notices

id (uuid, primary key)

title (text)

description (text)

created_at (timestamp)

Output Required:
SQL schema + confirmation of tables created.
